title: Luscious Charred Moroccan Egg Yolks Mrouzia
description:
A rich, flavorful, and shaggy Moroccan dish featuring wood-fired egg yolks.
Mrouzia is a traditional Moroccan dessert, but this version is ovo-vegetarian-friendly, making it a unique breakfast option.

ingredients.name: Egg yolks
ingredients.notes: Large eggs, separated from the whites and saved for another use.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: Raw, unfiltered honey for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Ground cinnamon for warmth and depth.

ingredients.name: Orange blossom water
ingredients.notes: Pure orange blossom water for exotic flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Flaky sea salt for savory depth.

instructions: Preheat a wood-fired oven or a conventional oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a small bowl, mix together the honey, ghee, cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, and salt.
In a separate bowl, gently beat the egg yolks until they're lightly broken up.
Add the pistachios, orange blossom water, and honey-ghee mixture to the egg yolks and stir until just combined.
Using a spoon, place the egg yolk mixture onto a sheet of parchment paper or a lightly oiled baking sheet, creating shaggy, uneven mounds.
Drizzle the tops with olive oil and place in the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the egg yolks are set and the tops are caramelized.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
